description: Nine planetary low-frequency voices, each shaped by the zodiac sign its planet is currently in, summed by the aspects between them, drawn as a chart of the moment on the panel

params.text: Scales the rate of all nine voices together, from a twentieth of their natural speed to twenty times it
Sets how wide an angle counts as an aspect, which sets how many aspects count and how strongly they weigh the main mix
Sets how fast simulated time runs, from real time up to a hundred million times it
Chooses whether the sky is the real one from the computer clock or the warped one the knob beside it drives

outputs.text: That planet's own waveform, ±5V, shaped by the sign it is transiting
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time that planet's voice completes a cycle
Every voice summed, each weighted by the strength of the aspects it is making, ±5V
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the slowest aspected planet completes a cycle

notes: it needs no clock and no input: the nine voices run from the planets' real positions and the computer clock
there are no gate outputs anywhere on this module; the triggers mark the end of a cycle and nothing holds high
the wheel on the panel shows the planets at their true longitudes, the aspects between them drawn as coloured chords, and a readout of the date and the strongest aspect
menu: Set time to now — puts the simulated date back to the present moment
